analysis:
This PR changes only documentation: a new changelog.d/qwen27-public-assistant.md and docs/architecture/inference.md (date bump, resource-policy-digest paragraph near head line 5253, and the Qwen27 assistant section near head lines 5379-5389). No executable code is in the supplied units, so I found no concrete security regression.

The docs describe a default-off, build-declared public tensor assistant (ClusterPublicModel.tensorAssistant). The relevant controls are:
- ClusterConfiguration.validate and ClusterApprovalAttachment.attachment refuse any non-declared assistant before any part stops.
- The resource policy digest (DistributedInstalledNativeStart.resourcePolicySHA256) binds the declared assistant's launch arguments and evidence digest. The member and its owner compare it through NativePairMemberPolicy.require.
- requireDiscoveredQuote requires the native helper to return exactly the declared policy, inventory included.
- The declaration is tied to a SHA-256 of an evidence report, and this build declares none.

Threat-model fit:
- TB-011 and T-054 (qualification and approval binding) are consistent with the digest binding.
- T-056 (overclaimed correctness) is acknowledged by the statement that the declaration needs real-pair evidence that tiny fixtures do not establish.
- The slot posture and telemetry change (engine_v2_slot_posture, MTP configured counts) exposes only counts, so there is no new prompt data exposure.

Integration questions for later passes, if source changes ship: (1) whether the evidence-report SHA-256 is actually verified against docs/reports/ or is only a declared string; (2) whether the coordinator side recomputes the digest with the assistant so approvals and starts stay consistent, since backend handling is platform-owned; (3) whether the prefix cache (T-041) keys account for assisted versus plain verify windows; the docs claim outputs are byte-identical but offer no evidence here.

The source is not supplied, so these claims about code behavior are unverified. The patch excerpt for inference.md is truncated, but the visible head text was reviewed.
